rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Presidency dates to 25 May 2019 Ramaphosa's 'Address by President Cyril Ramaphosa on the occasion of the Presidential Inauguration', delivered before heads of state and government, former Presidents and the Chief Justice.

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: In the same address Ramaphosa says 'I stand before you having just taken the oath to be President of our beautiful country South Africa' and later 'Having taken the oath of office'.
